name: Heberden and Bouchard Node Osteoarthritis
definition: Osteoarthritis of DIP and PIP joints producing characteristic bony enlargement known as Heberden and Bouchard nodes.

investigations.principle: Radiographs are used when diagnosis is uncertain or erosive/inflammatory disease is suspected.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, vascular, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

amber: Persistent severe disease may require specialist hand/rheumatology review.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Anguli Sandhigata-Vata phenotype may be documented.

patientEducation.summary: Osteoarthritis of DIP and PIP joints producing characteristic bony enlargement known as Heberden and Bouchard nodes.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, severe vascular symptoms, infection/systemic illness, major trauma, sphincter change or other listed red flags.
